Signed out: /app/settings redirects to /login and shows no workspace data
Signed out: /app/webhooks redirects to /login and shows no workspace data
Signed out: /admin redirects to /login and shows no workspace data
Signing in after the redirect returns to the page that was requested (/app/deals)
API without credentials -> 401 (no cookie, garbage bearer, tampered token)
Access cookie expires mid-use: navigating to Contacts refreshes silently (one POST /auth/refresh 200), page stays and shows data
Access cookie expires while a form is open: submit is retried after the refresh with the new X-CSRF-Token; contact saved, no login page
Several parallel 401s (full reload of a contact record without the access cookie) share ONE refresh; the record renders
CSRF: a cookie-authenticated POST without / with a wrong X-CSRF-Token -> 403, nothing created; GET needs no token
Signed-in user opening /login is sent to /app/dashboard
Session fully expired (access cookie gone, refresh token revoked): next action ends on /login with the stored user cleared
After a session expiry, signing in again returns to the page the user was on (not the dashboard)
Sign out (profile menu): /login, stored user cleared, auth cookies removed, the refresh token is revoked
Back button after sign-out does not show the contact record (stays on / returns to /login)
The access token captured before sign-out no longer works afterwards
Sign out in one tab: the other tab of the same browser ends on /login at its next action and shows no data
